functions.name: TAP
functions.description: One attribute of one Tapestry record, as of a date. Open the Tapestry pane to search attributes and records.

parameters.name: attribute
parameters.description: Attribute code, alias or name, such as "NAV". ENTITY_NAME and ENTITY_CODE are the record's own name and code.

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Record code or name, such as "FUND-1" or "Apex Fund".

parameters.name: as_of
parameters.description: Optional. A date, a date cell, or "YYYY-MM-DD". Blank means today.
